description: This file defines wrapper functions and constants for interacting with nl80211 Wi-Fi interface APIs, including functions for sending management frames, setting station info, and retrieving interface and station information, specifically for the wld (wireless driver layer) component.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a management frame command via nl80211 with specified parameters.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_setSta
methods.description: Sets station information for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_set4Mac
methods.description: Configures 4 MAC address usage for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information, including MLD and MLO link info, for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves station information for a remote AP BSSID.
